title: Hypothesis Testing: Where Do We Actually Use It in the Food Industry?
summary: We learn hypothesis testing with H₀, H₁, α, p-value, Z-test, t-test and ANOVA, but the practical question is where these methods are used in food factories and product-development projects.

title: A pathogen test says “NEGATIVE.” What does hypothesis testing actually tell us?
summary: A food-safety example using Salmonella testing explains the null and alternative hypotheses together with Type I and Type II errors.
